caseNameFull: Henry P. Reed v. Village of Hibbing
attorneys: Mr. C. A. Severance, Mr. H. B. Pryberger, Mr. George W. Morgan, and Mr. Oscar Mitchell for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6. Mr. H. V. Mercer for plaintiffs in' error.
